findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_portfolio_details" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get full details on a single model portfolio: its underlying vault allocations, the live APY of each underlying vault, and the blended portfolio APY. Use this when the user asks about a specific portfolio like "what is in Core on Ethereum" or "how does Foundation on Base work"."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
